---
title: "Popularity of the Name Gabriella Over Time"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the baby names data created by download.py
baby_names <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter for female babies named Gabriella and plot counts by year
baby_names |>
  filter(name == "Gabriella", sex == "F") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named Gabriella in the U.S. Over Time",
    subtitle = "Social Security Administration baby names data",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Compare Gabriella and Gabrielle over the years where either name appears
baby_names |>
  filter(name %in% c("Gabriella", "Gabrielle"), sex == "F") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, color = name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Was Gabriella More Popular Than Gabrielle?",
    subtitle = "Annual U.S. births for female babies named Gabriella vs. Gabrielle",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Name",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Compare Gabriella and Gabriel across both boys (M) and girls (F)
baby_names |>
  filter(name %in% c("Gabriella", "Gabriel")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, color = name, linetype = sex)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Was Gabriella More Popular Than Gabriel Among Boys and Girls?",
    subtitle = "Annual U.S. births for Gabriella and Gabriel by sex",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Name",
    linetype = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
